title: QA Engineer
description: Job Title: Junior QA Engineer (Full-Time) Role Overview We are looking for a detail-oriented QA Test Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and usability of our web and mobile applications through rigorous manual and automated testing. You will work closely with developers in an Agile/Scrum environment to identify, document, and resolve software defects. Key Responsibilities Test Strategy & Execution: Assist in the development and execution of comprehensive test plans, cases, and scripts. Application Testing: Perform manual testing across web and mobile platforms to uncover bugs and usability gaps. Automation Support: Support the team in automation testing efforts using frameworks such as Selenium or JUnit . Defect Management: Document software defects clearly and collaborate with the engineering team to ensure timely resolutions. Agile Collaboration: Actively participate in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews. Process Growth: Contribute to the evolution of our internal QA processes and testing standards. Required Skills & Qualifications Education: Pursuing or completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT , or a related technical field. Experience: 2–4 years of experience is preferred. Core Knowledge: Solid understanding of both SDLC and STLC frameworks. Technical Proficiency: Hands-on experience with manual testing concepts and the ability to work with automation scripts. Soft Skills: Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and communication abilities. Preferred Skills (Good to Have) Tools: Familiarity with JIRA, TestRail, Selenium, or Postman . Technical Depth: Basic knowledge of SQL and API testing . Methodology: Direct experience working within an Agile environment. Why Join Us? Real-World Impact: Gain hands-on experience in a fast-paced QA environment. Growth & Mentorship: Receive direct guidance from senior QA engineers and developers. Career Path: High-performing interns have the opportunity to transition into a permanent full-time QA Engineer role. Compensation & Benefits Type: Full-time or Internship. Perks: Health insurance and Provident Fund (PF) benefits. Location: In-person (Office-based). Job Types: Full-time, Permanent Pay: ₹300,000.00 - ₹400,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

title: Software Dev Engineer I, L4
description: DESCRIPTION You use technology to validate and verify software, seeking input from team members on the best software test techniques to utilize. Your scope of work is to extend and effectively apply existing automation frameworks for small to mid-size components and/or product features. You may create or have responsibility to improve existing test tools. You are able to take a defined design and turn it into code and deliver it on schedule, applying appropriate technologies and current software engineering best practices. You write secure, stable, testable, maintainable code with minimal defects. You are proficient in a broad range of data structures and algorithms, knowing when it is appropriate to use them (and when it is not). You make appropriate implementation trade-off decisions (e.g., array or hash table?). You do not put the company at risk (e.g. pulling in unlicensed code, working on code in unsafe ways, test payment transactions in prod, etc.). You participate in team design, scoping and prioritization discussions. Your input to test plans and test cases are of high quality and high value. You seek to learn the business context and technologies behind your team’s software. You invent, refine and develop your solutions to ensure they are meeting team needs and project goals. You are a passionate advocate for your customer. You assume responsibility for the state of the code you inherit, produce, and test. You get your designs, code, and test plans reviewed. You test code thoroughly. You classify, store, and handle data in accordance with Amazon policies. You track risks and mitigate and/or escalate them in a timely manner. You take the time to understand the maintenance characteristics, runtime properties, and dependencies of your team’s software, including hardware platform, operating system and build dependencies. You prevent bugs from causing customer pain. You clearly document your software to ensure that future generations of developers understand the intention behind the test solutions you build. You troubleshoot, research the root cause of problems, and thoroughly resolve defects. You take ownership of problems (even when outside your own domain), propose solutions, and either take ownership for their resolution or ensure a clear hand-off to the right owner. You participate in the interview process and help your team train and mentor SDE-T interns. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering Experience of 1 to 3 years as an SDE PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Exposure to AWS, Full stack development experience Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Intern
description: About REVERSE REVERSE is a Bengaluru-based cleantech startup building India’s packaging reuse infrastructure. Most packaging in India is used once and discarded, even when it can be reused multiple times. We work with brands to enable circularity for their packaging by building the systems, technology and supply chain required to collect, sort, sanitise and return packaging back into use. Our network currently includes housing societies, restaurants, hotels, cafés, collection partners and brands across Bengaluru. Today, REVERSE has: Enabled the reuse of 4.7M+ packaging units Worked with 15+ brands Built 355+ return points across Bengaluru and Goa Been supported by leading startup and innovation ecosystems, including IIM Bangalore and IIM Ahmedabad. We are now hiring interns across multiple functions to work closely with our team and help us scale packaging reuse. Open Internship Role: 1. Brand Strategy & GTM Intern (You will work on how REVERSE is positioned, communicated, and taken to market.) Key responsibilities include: Support brand strategy, positioning and communication Plan and execute growth and behaviour-change campaigns Conduct customer and market research Interact with residents, businesses, brands and channel partners Support go-to-market plans for housing societies, cafés, restaurants and other channels Experiment with messaging, acquisition channels and engagement strategies Track campaign and customer conversion data Support partnerships and new market initiatives This role is ideal for someone interested in branding, marketing, consumer behaviour, strategy, growth and entrepreneurship. 2. Supply Chain Intern (You will work closely with our operations team to understand and improve the end-to-end supply chain behind packaging reuse.) Key responsibilities include: Support onboarding and management of collection and channel partners Analyse logistics routes, costs, and operational efficiency Help improve collection, segregation, inventory and dispatch processes Work on lean operations and process improvement initiatives Maintain and analyse operational and supply chain data Support implementation of SCM and internal tracking tools Identify bottlenecks and recommend process improvements Work with field teams, warehouses and partners to improve execution This role is ideal for someone interested in supply chain, operations, logistics, analytics and process optimisation. 3. Tech Intern - Computer Vision / Robotics / Mechanical / Computer Science (You will work with our technology and engineering team on products that enable packaging reuse at scale.) Depending on your background, you may work on: Computer vision models for packaging and SKU identification Image processing and AI-based sorting systems Robotics and automation for packaging segregation Mechanical design and integration of sorting systems Sensors, actuators, and conveyor-based automation ERP, inventory and operations management modules Backend, frontend and data management systems Testing, deployment and performance improvement of live systems This role is ideal for students from Computer Science, AI/ML, Robotics, Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics or related disciplines who enjoy building and testing real-world systems. What You Can Expect At REVERSE, interns are expected to take ownership of real projects rather than work only on support tasks. You will have the opportunity to: Work directly with the founding and core team Solve real operational and technology problems See your work deployed in the field Work across business, technology, and sustainability Learn how an early-stage cleantech company scales Take ownership of projects with measurable outcomes Internship Details Location: Bengaluru Work model: Hybrid Duration: 6 months Internship: Paid PPO: Opportunity available for high-performing interns We are looking for people who are curious, hands-on, comfortable taking ownership, and excited about building systems that create measurable environmental impact. If you want to work on a problem where technology, business, operations, and sustainability come together, we would love to hear from you.

Leveraging decreasing computation costs and increasing computational power, the company builds tailored AI solutions that align closely with client objectives. Beige Bananas maintains an outcome-driven mindset, helping organizations accelerate value realization from their analytics and AI investments. The firm serves Fortune 500 companies across Retail, CPG, and Media sectors, building long-term partnerships based on trust and measurable results. Role Description As a Data Scientist Intern at Beige Bananas, you will collaborate with senior data scientists and consultants to design, test, and refine data-driven solutions for client projects. On a day-to-day basis, you will clean and prepare datasets, conduct exploratory data analysis, build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models, and create clear visualizations and reports to communicate findings. You will contribute to proof-of-concept AI products, document methodologies, and support the translation of business questions into analytical approaches. This is a remote internship role, requiring proactive communication, reliable time management, and the ability to work effectively within distributed teams. Qualifications Strong foundation in Data Science and Statistics, with the ability to apply quantitative methods to real-world problems. Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Analysis, including cleaning, transforming, and interpreting complex datasets. Experience with Data Visualization, using tools or libraries (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn) to present insights clearly. Hands-on skills in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and familiarity with SQL. Knowledge of basic machine learning concepts and frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or similar) is beneficial. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related discipline. Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, structured, and concise manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfort working in a remote environment, with strong organizational skills and a collaborative, outcome-focused mindset.

title: AI/ML Research Intern
description: Company: The Wedding Company (TWC) Location: Bengaluru Type: Full-time Internship (6 months) | PPO Opportunity Eligibility: M.Tech/MS students or recent graduates in AI, ML, Computer Science, or related fields About The Wedding Company The Wedding Company is building an AI-powered operating system for the wedding industry , combining visual intelligence, conversational AI, personalized recommendations, and data-driven decision-making. AI is at the core of our platform, powering real-world products used by customers and internal teams. We work with large proprietary datasets of wedding images, customer conversations, and historical wedding information. We're looking for a passionate AI/ML Research Intern with strong fundamentals in Machine Learning, Computer Vision, and Generative AI who can improve existing AI systems and help build new capabilities. This is a hands-on research and engineering role with significant technical ownership and an opportunity to transition into a full-time AI/ML Engineer position. What You'll Work On 1. AI Decor Intelligence System (Existing) Our AI-powered decor platform uses embeddings, clustering, and visual similarity to generate personalized, aesthetically coherent wedding mood boards from 40,000+ curated decor images. Develop and optimize image embedding and similarity search pipelines. Improve semantic matching, visual coherence, and intelligent image recommendations. Experiment with computer vision, multimodal models, and generative AI techniques. Scale image retrieval and recommendation systems toward 100,000+ images. 2. AI Ideabook — Multimodal Search (Existing) Our inspiration discovery platform supports text-to-image and image-to-image search across 25,000+ wedding-related images. Improve natural-language and reference-image search. Experiment with models such as CLIP, SigLIP, and other open-source embedding architectures. Optimize vector search, retrieval accuracy, and ranking algorithms. 3. AI Meeting & Product Intelligence (Existing) Our platform uses speech recognition and LLMs to transform customer conversations and behavioral data into actionable intelligence. Work on speech-to-text transcription and LLM-based conversation analysis. Extract user preferences, decisions, action items, and risks. Build intelligent classification, prediction, and recommendation systems. Combine conversational insights with product usage and behavioral signals. 4. Domain-Specific LLM & RAG Platform (Upcoming) We're developing an AI-powered wedding planning assistant using proprietary wedding data, historical insights, and multimodal retrieval. Research and develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines. Experiment with open-source LLMs, Gemini, and models accessible through OpenRouter. Build context-aware retrieval and personalized recommendation capabilities. Explore multimodal RAG, fine-tuning, and AI agents. Technical Skills & Requirements Must Have Strong Python programming and ML/DL fundamentals. Knowledge of PyTorch or TensorFlow. Understanding of Computer Vision, image processing, embeddings, clustering, and semantic similarity. Familiarity with transformers, neural networks, and model training. Hands-on familiarity with Hugging Face and open-source AI models . Understanding of the ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, optimization, and deployment. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to independently experiment with AI models. Good to Have Experience with CLIP, SigLIP, DINO, or other vision-language models. Familiarity with vector databases such as Weaviate, FAISS, Qdrant, or Milvus. Experience with LLMs, OpenRouter, RAG, or AI agents. Knowledge of model fine-tuning, LoRA/QLoRA, quantization, and GPU inference. Exposure to speech recognition, NLP, FastAPI, Docker, or cloud infrastructure. Experience implementing research papers, customizing models, or contributing to open-source AI projects. Who Should Apply? We're looking for M.Tech/MS/Masters/Postgrad students who: Have built meaningful AI/ML projects, particularly in Computer Vision, Deep Learning, or Generative AI. Enjoy exploring Hugging Face, GitHub repositories, and new research papers. Can understand, modify, fine-tune, and experiment with existing ML models. Have strong analytical abilities and enjoy translating research into practical applications. Want to own real AI systems rather than just integrate third-party APIs. Prior industry experience is not required. Strong academic projects, research implementations, and GitHub contributions are highly valued. Why Join TWC? Work on real AI products using proprietary image and conversational datasets. Experiment with modern open-source models and multimodal AI technologies. Gain end-to-end ownership of AI systems, from research to production. Work directly with the founding and engineering teams. Opportunity for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) based on performance.
